//: Paste the hooks block into .claude/settings.json (project) or ~/.claude/settings.json (global). Every Bash/Task/WebFetch/WebSearch call preauthorizes 1 against the 'claude' topic; a 429 blocks the tool call (exit 2) and the stderr line tells Claude why it stopped. Set the cap first: curl -X PUT '$METER_URL/claude?cap=500&period=day&unit=calls'. Generate a customized copy with: meter hook <topic> --url <server>.

hooks.command: code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m 5 -X POST -d 1 "${METER_URL:-https://meter.sh}/claude/spend"); if [ "$code" = "429" ]; then echo "meter: claude is over budget — raise the cap: ${METER_URL:-https://meter.sh}/claude" >&2; exit 2; fi
